## Client checks

The newest verdict of each guided check (`[ClientCheck]`, docs/kiln/client-pass.md). A verdict says what
whoever answered it saw. Session `server` was answered through a dedicated server's control folder, and on a lab
a `joined` verdict can come from a scripted client: both prove the check runner, not the game. A pass is a
real-client statement only when a player gave it in the game client.
